title: Preparation: Remaining Close to Jesus
headline: What Would Change If You Listened Better?
tagline: The answer you’re seeking may not require God to speak louder.
seo_title: What Would Change If You Listened Better? John 8:31-32 | TheWrkShop
seo_description: The answer you're seeking may not require God to speak louder; it may require remaining closer to Jesus. A short reflection on John 8:31-32.
verse_text: If you abide in My word, you are truly My disciples, and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

scriptures.text: If you abide in My word, you are truly My disciples, and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

blocks.text: Before entering into the new week, ask yourself:
What would change if I became a better listener?

items: To those who disagree with me?
The answer you’re seeking may not require God to speak louder.
It may simply require you to remain closer to Jesus.

blocks.text: Because the One who said, “I am the Truth” also invites us to abide in His Word until that Truth reshapes our hearts.
